ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity dark pixels to 35% high-intensity white pixels; high contrast localized primarily at the distal lateral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions are mapped to the outer 30% of both the left and right lobes; the central 40% consists of low-intensity dark pixels interspersed with high-frequency, low-diameter white speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximately 45-degree convergence angle with a clearly defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge; irregular distribution of sharp pixel-peaks and narrow valleys, particularly pronounced on the inner half of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge transitioning into sharp, upwardly-tapered distal tips; leading edge (lower boundary) exhibits a smooth convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) scattered across the dark medial regions of both lobes, consistent with localized surface scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical and diagonal high-contrast linear disruptions visible on the medial surface of the left lobe, intersecting the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately 1/3 distance from the tip; heavy white scarring/pigmentation loss at the extreme distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density 'salt-and-pepper' mottling transition zone between the solid dark central pixels and the solid white outer-margin pixels.
